description: Saudi fintech founded 2021, closed joint-stock company (paid-up capital SAR 112m, CR 1010734817), operating the 'Awaed' digital investment platform. Licensed by the CMA (March 2023) for Dealing, Asset Management and Custody activities; marketed as the first fully CMA-licensed, commission-free trading app in Saudi Arabia, targeting retail investors with Sharia-compliant products. Partnered with Investcorp (Feb 2025) to distribute the Investcorp Saudi Pre-IPO Growth Fund to its retail user base.

fit.disqualified_reason: Retail digital brokerage / commission-free consumer trading app despite holding a CMA asset-management licence -- matches the ICP's explicit disqualification criterion for retail brokerages wanting a consumer product rather than a management platform. Recording this so we do not re-research the same firm next quarter.
